Description: Log in via the shared login flow (identity-provider steps are shared infrastructure - one callReusable)
Navigate to the projects landing page
Poll for the landing page (app cold-starts slowly and never goes network-idle)
Project name (made unique per run so re-runs are not rejected as duplicates)
Pick Start Date in the calendar (shared handler reads project.StartDate; value must be M/d/yyyy or yyyy-MM-dd)
Phase (Optional) - tolerant (Optional): this env moved General fields to Program/Indication; Phase is administrative and does not affect the computed design
Treatment Arm name (Control Arm left at the app default - testdata only overrides the treatment arm)
Endpoint Type is a TABLE-CELL dropdown: open via its value-trigger (role button "Time to Event", the fresh-project default) then pick Continuous. GADSD-proven pattern

Better Response is a TABLE-CELL dropdown: open via its value-trigger (role button "Larger Value", the Continuous default) then pick the direction. MUST run after Endpoint Type=Continuous (its options depend on it)
Input-set collection name (mapped to the existing InputSetname column - no new column)
Pick the statistical test from the inputset SelectTest (Difference of Means) - the react-select test card
Hypothesis (Superiority / Noninferiority / Super Superiority) - controls which margin fields render
Computed Parameter radio (Sample Size / Power / Type 1 Error / Difference in Means) - greys out the chosen output
Sample Size (skips when Computed - it is the solved-for output that iteration)
Type 1 Error (symmetric). Asymmetric upper/lower alpha are added when ITER_02 is stabilized
Test Type (1-Sided / 2-Sided / 2-Sided Asymmetric) - MUST precede the Type-1-Error fields (asymmetric splits into Upper/Lower)
Upper Type 1 Error (2-Sided Asymmetric only; #upperType1Error). N/A for symmetric iterations
Lower Type 1 Error (2-Sided Asymmetric only; #lowerType1Error). N/A for symmetric iterations
Input Method (Individual Means / Difference of Means / Standardized Diff.) - controls which effect field renders
Noninferiority Mean Control (editable; was defaulting - correctness fix)
Noninferiority Difference in Means (#nonInf_differenceInMeans - fixed from the importer's differenceInMeans guess)
Super Superiority Margin (Super Superiority hypothesis only; #supsup_margin)
Super Superiority alt Difference in Means
Super Superiority null Mean Treatment (verify editable vs computed at runtime)
Variance (Equal / Unequal) - controls common SD vs per-arm SD
SD Control (Unequal variance; #sdControl - fixed from the importer's standardDeviation guess)
SD Treatment (Unequal variance; #sdTreatment - fixed from the importer's standardDeviation guess)
Include Assurance ON (reveals prior distribution + input method); gated per iteration. NOTE: this column uses TRUE/FALSE (not check/uncheck like IncludeEnrollment)
Include Assurance OFF; gated per iteration (TRUE/FALSE convention). Never fires today - iterations that skip assurance leave it blank (default off)
Prior Distribution (Normal / Uniform) - Uniform reveals Min/Max
Assurance Input Method - controls which prior-elicitation fields render (E/SD vs percentiles)
Prior E(delta) (#eDelta - fixed from the importer's bare-label E guess)
Prior SD(delta) (#sdDelta - fixed from the importer's bare-label SD guess)
Asymmetric efficacy boundary family (#asymEffBoundaryFam) - fires ONLY on 2-Sided Asymmetric (Test-Type gated)
Efficacy Boundary Family (#effBoundaryFam) - SYMMETRIC only; asymmetric uses #asymEffBoundaryFam (Test-Type gated)
Efficacy Spending Function - single/symmetric (#effSpendFunc). N/A on asymmetric iterations (they use upper/lower)
Upper efficacy spending function (2-Sided Asymmetric only; #upperSpendFunc). N/A for symmetric
Lower efficacy spending function (2-Sided Asymmetric only; #lowerSpendFunc). N/A for symmetric
Efficacy Rho parameter (#effParamRho - fixed from the importer's Computed-Parameter guess)
Futility Boundary Family (#futBoundaryFam) - controls which futility fields render
Futility Rho parameter (#futParamRho - hand-added selector; ITER_01 = 4.55)
Reconcile the interim table to the testdata's interim count (clicks Add Interim; fixed designs = no-op). MUST run before the per-period fills

loopPeriods (Option C): fill boundary analysisSpacingInfo per period from design_boundary — count-agnostic; replaces the enumerated per-period spacing fills. Checks stay enumerated LAST (means-family requirement); reconcile above still sizes the table.
Interim 0 Upper alpha (2-Sided Asymmetric Interpolated - required per-analysis; N/A on symmetric)
Calculate the GSD boundary. SKIPPED for FIXED designs (effBoundaryFam empty = no boundary table, so no Calculate button - it would time out). Boundary checkbox toggles go LAST, just before this
Include Enrollment ON (reveals avg subjects enrolled); gated per iteration (maps to IncludeEnrollment)
Include Enrollment OFF; gated per iteration
Average subjects enrolled (design enrollment is a single scalar; #enrollmentTable.0.avgSubjectsEnrolled)
Name the result in the credit dialog (#inputId) - runtime token keeps it unique per iteration with no new testdata column
Confirm the credit dialog to start the compute (#credit-alert-primary)
Poll the run status until Completed before opening the result
Open the computed result by its (distinct) name once compute finishes
Capture EVERY table on the result page (shared _shared/customSteps.extractAllResultTables)
Compare captured cells vs 06_baseline/AD/. First run writes the baseline (green but verifies nothing); a second run is a real PASS/FAIL
